description: Schedule the agent FSM and expose public control, stable state, and state flux files; on_start / on_stop fire the after_start / after_stop hooks through aos-hook (a failing hook stops the loop). The definition hooks nothing on before_run / after_run, so on_before_run / on_after_run are not wired: to hook them add those two keys like on_start (events before_run / after_run) and restart the agent.
